[[Image:Necronomicon.png|right|160px]]
'''Necronomicon''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, draw 1 [[Spell]] and lose 2 [[Sanity]].  If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $6

==Mythos Source==

The Necronomicon first appears in H.P. Lovecraft's story ''The Hound'' (1922), although it makes numerous other appearances in Lovecraft's works, notably: ''The Call of Cthulhu'' (1928), ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1929), ''At the Mountains of Madness'' (1936), and ''The Case of Charles Dexter Ward'' (1941).
